title: Karnataka's Wildlife — Vanita Sadana, Mysore
teaser: A science outreach programme on Karnataka's wildlife was organized at Vanita Sadana, Mysore. Dr. Mewa Singh spoke on elephants and monkeys, and naturalist Manu spoke on birds.
homepageMatter: A science outreach programme on Karnataka's wildlife was organized at Vanita Sadana, Krishnamurthypuram, Mysore on 4 August 2018. Dr. Mewa Singh, wildlife scientist, spoke on elephants and monkeys, and Manu, Mysore's noted naturalist, spoke on birds.
